# TKJ Skanesga - Telecommunication & Computer Networks

Official website of the TKJ (Telecommunication and Computer Networks) department at SMKN 1 Seyegan, Indonesia. A vocational school program specializing in fiber optics, MikroTik networking, server virtualization, VoIP systems, and digital entrepreneurship.

## Programs

- [Digital Entrepreneurship](https://tkjskanesga.github.io/) - Web development and digital solutions from architecture to deployment
- [Wide Area Network](https://tkjskanesga.github.io/) - Wireless technologies, VoIP, Point-to-Point links, and Fiber Optic installation
- [Network Infrastructure Administration](https://tkjskanesga.github.io/) - MikroTik enterprise solutions and MTCNA standards
- [Network Systems Administration](https://tkjskanesga.github.io/) - Server environments using Debian and Proxmox virtualization
- [Advanced Network Engineering](https://tkjskanesga.github.io/) - Enterprise-grade network design and optimization
